name: The fulfilment chain of mindfulness of breathing (MN 118)

definitions.definition: MN 118:15 announces and MN 118:16-43 explains a chain: mindfulness of breathing, developed and cultivated, fulfils the four establishments of mindfulness (via the four tetrads, 23-28); these fulfil the seven awakening factors (29-40); these fulfil knowledge and liberation (41-43).

relations.note: mindfulness of breathing fulfils the four establishments (tetrad 1 = body, 2 = feelings, 3 = mind, 4 = dhammas)
the four establishments fulfil the seven awakening factors

definitions.definition: MN 118:30-36: aroused in sequence while the four establishments are practised: mindfulness, investigation of dhammas, energy, rapture, tranquillity, concentration, equanimity, each arising in dependence on the one before; developed supported by seclusion, dispassion and cessation and ripening in relinquishment, they fulfil knowledge and liberation (mn118:42-43).

name: The four establishments of mindfulness (cattāro satipaṭṭhānā)

definitions.definition: In MN 118 they are fulfilled by mindfulness of breathing (each tetrad of the sixteen steps is one foundation: body, feelings, mind, dhammas) and, developed, they fulfil the seven awakening factors (MN 118:23-40); a monk community 'devoted to their development' is described at mn118:13.
